text: 行途技术技能包将 30 个可按需调用的 agent skill 接入 DSH 的 session skill catalog，涵盖记忆文件压缩、代码审查、证据核实、安全重构、迁移和工程简化等工作。插件遍历 skills 目录，为每个技能读取 SKILL.md 的描述和正文，并通过 skills 服务注册，按任务需要逐步展开。适合希望在 DSH 中直接调用成套工程实践与内容核实流程的用户。安装插件即可加载技能；压缩与用量核实等个别技能可能需要相应本地文件或配置。

XingTu Skills adds 30 on-demand skills to DSH, including memory compression, code review, fact checking, refactoring, and migration workflows. It reads each skill’s SKILL.md and registers it with DSH’s skills service. Users call skills when needed; some require relevant local files or configuration.

行途技能包的功能「记忆文件压缩」：Caveman Compress 接收文件路径，按技能说明压缩自然语言记忆文件，保留代码、路径和结构，并生成便于阅读的备份。

dsh-xingtu-skills README · What is this：This plugin packages the **30 production-grade SKILL.md skills** from [xingtu-skills](https://github.com/xingtu1996/xingtu-skills) into a standard DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle. After install, DSH's session skill catalog loads all skills automatically and triggers them on demand (progressive disclosure) — no manual copying.

Each skill follows the cross-tool de-facto standard (`name + description + when_to_use`) and is also compatible with Claude Code / CodeBuddy / Codex / Cursor / Gemini CLI.

dsh-xingtu-skills README · From npm (recommended)：dsh plugin add dsh-xingtu-skills

dsh-xingtu-skills README · From the GitHub release tarball：dsh plugin add -w https://github.com/xingtu1996/dsh-xingtu-skills/releases/latest/download/dsh-xingtu-skills-0.1.2.tgz
```

dsh-xingtu-skills README · Structure：```
dsh-xingtu-skills/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch → ./cordis.patch.yml (standard plugin declaration)
├── cordis.patch.yml    # inserts this plugin row (bundle layer)
├── lib/index.js        # entry: apply() registers every SKILL.md under skills/

dsh-xingtu-skills README · Structure：- **Plugin contract**: exports `name` + `apply(ctx)` (`inject: ['skills']`); every contribution goes through `ctx.effect()` / `ctx.skills.register()` and is auto-disposed on unload.
- **Zero dependencies**: no Cordis copy is bundled; `@deepseek-ai/dsh` is only an optional peerDependency.
- **Validated**: passes `dsh-plugin-dev check` (static checks) + `dsh-plugin-dev verify` (clean-DSH_HOME install / boot / uninstall).
